title: Lightly Aerated Algerian Fiordilatte Papillote
description: A refreshing and light Algerian dish featuring Fiordilatte cheese, perfect for high-protein diets and warm weather.
instructions: Cut the Fiordilatte cheese into 1-inch (2.5 cm) cubes.
In a small bowl, mix together the lemon juice, garlic, and olive oil.
Add the chopped mint leaves and parsley to the bowl and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the cheese cubes in a small papillote and spoon the mint mixture over the top.
Fold the papillote over the cheese and seal the edges with a small amount of water.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it cool for 2 minutes.
Serve the Fiordilatte papillote warm, garnished with additional mint leaves if desired.
